description: Innovision Limited provides manpower services, toll plaza management, and skill development training in India. It offers manned private security services, integrated facility management services, manpower sourcing and payrolling services; fee collection and other related services at toll plazas; and skill development training as a training partner for various central and state government schemes, as well as drone flying training services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Gurugram, India.
